newsitem.title: POLAND: IB Austria rates Sanok as "hold".
newsitem.headline: IB Austria rates Sanok as "hold".

text.p: Investmentbank Austria recommended in its June report to hold shares of Polish rubber maker Stomil Sanok SA, saying demand for its products was on the rise and will lift profits.
"Economic growth in Poland and further increases in consumer spending will result in growing demand for durable goods. Thus we should expect strong demand for Sanok products," the reports said.
IB Austria said it forecast Sanok's net profit to increase to 16.3 zlotys in 1997 and 20.1 million zlotys next year from last year's 15.1 zlotys.
It predicted the company's sales would increase to 183.7 million zlotys this year and 225 million in 1998 from 138.5 million zlotys last year.
